memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Visit for fatigue and pallor suspected iron deficiency.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: The patient reports progressive tiredness over the past two months, mild dyspnoea on exertion, and notices pallor of the skin. No bleeding symptoms reported.
EXAMINATION: BP 118/72 mmHg, weight 68 kg, height 1.65 m, BMI 24.9 (overweight). Conjunctival pallor noted, otherwise cardiovascular and respiratory exams normal.
IMPRESSION: Iron‑deficiency anaemia likely; concurrent vitamin D deficiency suspected given low sunlight exposure and dietary intake.
ARRANGEMENTS: Order fasting haemoglobin, serum ferritin, MCV, serum 25‑hydroxyvitamin D, calcium and phosphate. Start ferrous sulfate 200 mg OD and cholecalciferol 60000 IU once weekly for 8 weeks. Advise iron‑rich diet, increase fruit and vegetables, and regular low‑impact activity. Offer influenza vaccine; to be given in autumn.
Return if: chest pain, breathlessness at rest, fever >39 °C, or blood in stools.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Ferrous sulfate 200 mg tablet, take one tablet daily.
Cholecalciferol 60000 IU capsule, take one capsule once weekly for 8 weeks.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Follow‑up after 3 months of therapy.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient feels less tired, reports improved stamina; no new bleeding or GI symptoms.
EXAMINATION: BP 120/74 mmHg, weight 68 kg, BMI 24.9 (overweight). Conjunctiva less pale, no lymphadenopathy.
IMPRESSION: Haemoglobin rising, ferritin improving; vitamin D still low but trending up.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue ferrous sulfate 200 mg OD, switch vitamin D to cholecalciferol 1000 IU OD. Reinforce diet advice and activity. Influenza vaccine offered for autumn.
Return if: chest pain, breathlessness > mild exertion, fever >39 °C, or melena.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Six‑month review.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports feeling well, no fatigue, occasional mild tiredness after long walks.
EXAMINATION: BP 119/73 mmHg, weight 68 kg, BMI 24.9 (overweight). Conjunctiva normal pink.
IMPRESSION: Haemoglobin near normal, ferritin borderline; vitamin D sufficient after maintenance dose.
ARRANGEMENTS: Change ferrous sulfate to 200 mg on alternate days. Continue cholecalciferol 1000 IU OD. Give influenza vaccine today (02‑Oct‑2025). Advise maintain balanced diet and regular exercise.
Return if: chest pain, dyspnoea at rest, fever >39 °C, or rectal bleeding.

Cholecalciferol 1000 IU tablet, take one tablet daily.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Winter check‑up.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient denies any symptoms; feels energetic.
EXAMINATION: BP 121/75 mmHg, weight 68 kg, BMI 24.9 (overweight). No pallor.
IMPRESSION: Iron stores adequate, vitamin D maintained on replacement.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue ferrous sulfate 200 mg on alternate days and cholecalciferol 1000 IU OD. Influenza vaccine already given autumn 2025; note status.
Return if: chest pain, unexplained breathlessness, fever >39 °C, or blood in stool.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Spring review.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports occasional mild fatigue after work; otherwise well.
EXAMINATION: BP 120/73 mmHg, weight 68 kg, BMI 24.9 (overweight). Conjunctiva normal.
IMPRESSION: Haemoglobin stable, ferritin satisfactory; vitamin D adequate.
ARRANGEMENTS: Stop ferrous sulfate as haemoglobin now within normal range. Continue cholecalciferol 1000 IU OD. Advise diet rich in iron and maintain activity.
Return if: chest pain, dyspnoea on exertion, fever >39 °C, or melena.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Ferrous sulfate – discontinued.
Cholecalciferol 1000 IU tablet, take one tablet daily.
